title: fix(app-shell): an app whose navigation holds only doc entries opens its first doc
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbLCajCYUR31RRZKTSbAZhke)_
Fixes #29678

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：控制台打开一个应用的根地址时，若导航里没有对象、页面、仪表盘、报表或组件条目可落地，就打开成员能看到的第一个文档条目（应用内文档门户）。设计器预览里的“首页”提示同步这条规则。
- **为什么改**：导航只有文档条目的应用，打开后主区域一片空白，没有跳转也没有空状态，管理员、读者、外部成员都一样（#29672 QA 实测，本 PR 现场复现）。
- **风险与回滚**：只在原来什么都不落地的情况下生效；第一条是文档、后面有对象的应用照旧落到第一个对象。文档的可读性由服务端把关：成员读不了的文档条目服务端已从导航里去掉，此时仍是“无权限”空状态。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 的 `resolveLandingRoute`（兜底顺序）与 `findFirstRoute`（类型集合参数化）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppPreview.tsx` 的 `findFirstLanding`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.docOnlyLanding-29678.test.tsx`，应见 7 个用例全绿：纯文档应用落到 `/apps/APP/docs/BOOK`，各对照组照旧。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Claim: issuecomment 6593568853 (round 30), amended by 6593605696 (AppPreview parity).

An app whose navigation holds only `doc` entries opened `/apps/APP` to an empty `main`: `findFirstRoute` lands on object, page, dashboard, report and component entries only, and `AppRootLanding` rendered `null` when none landed.

- **`AppContent.tsx`**: `findFirstRoute` takes the set of entry types it lands on (default: the five it always took). `resolveLandingRoute` is now: the declared landing, else the first working entry, else the first `doc` entry the member is shown (groups walked, `url` passed over). A `doc` entry's route is the one the sidebar follows, `resolveHref`'s in-app docs portal (`docs/BOOK[/DOC]` under the app), which the console host mounts in its `extraRoutes`.
- Docs are a last resort, not a tree-order peer: an app whose first entry is its manual, followed by working entries, still opens on its first working entry, as before and as the designer preview's existing pin states.
- The doc is gated as a declared `doc` landing already is (#28450): by the server's audience gate on the app read (it drops an unreadable `doc` entry) and on the doc read. The sidebar's own doc-readability answer (`useNavDocTargetCheck`) is NOT available to the landing without a new wait: it is a lazy `doc`/`book` list read that answers `undefined` (pass every entry) until it loads, so on the landing's first render it never has an answer. Measured live below: a doc behind a book the member may not read never reaches the landing, because the server already dropped its entry.
- The pending-read hold (objectui#13097) is unchanged: both of its landing reads go through `resolveLandingRoute`, so a pending bound entry ahead of the doc still holds the skeleton.
- **`AppPreview.tsx`** (amendment): `findFirstLanding` mirrors the runtime, so the designer preview names the first doc as the landing when nothing else lands.
- The `return null` branch now covers only apps whose entries are all `url`/`action` links or live only under `areas`; its comment says so.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.docOnlyLanding-29678.test.tsx` (7, harness as `AppContent.landingWaitsReads-13097.test.tsx`, with the host's docs route stubbed): a doc-only app lands on its first doc; a doc inside a group behind a `url` link; CONTROL first entry a doc then an object lands on the object; CONTROL object app redirects; CONTROL no navigation keeps `AppNoAccessEmptyState`; CONTROL a pending bound entry ahead of the doc holds the skeleton and lands on the bound entry when shown; the same pending entry failing lands on the doc.
- `AppPreview.docEntry-11197.test.tsx`: one new case, a `url` + two `doc` entries names the first doc as the landing. The existing "→ Accounts" pin is unchanged and green.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation verified on disk, restored to HEAD with an empty git diff)</summary>

- Drop the doc fallback in `resolveLandingRoute`: 3 failed / 4 passed (the two doc-only cases and the pending-then-fail case red; the four controls green).
- Drop the doc pass in `AppPreview`: 1 failed / 3 passed (the new preview case red).
</details>

<details><summary>Sweep</summary>

Every ui test file importing `AppContent` or `AppPreview` (59 files, `git grep -l`), two locked batches at 2 workers, on the merged head e5ff1941: 31/31 files 202 tests, 28/28 files 333 tests. The same 59 files were green on d8352d2f before the merge of main (30/30 201, 29/29 334). `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check exit 0 on e5ff1941.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Live measurement (showcase `--fresh` backend, Vite console on this branch's source, 1440x900): package `com.qa.r29678` with a published doc `r29678_guide`, a doc-only app `r29678_help` (one `doc` entry), a control app `r29678_ctrl` (one `object` entry), and `r29678_locked_app` whose only entry opens a book gated to a permission set nobody holds. Signed in as admin, as `auditor.demo` (reader) and as `phone.demo` (outsider):
  - before (AppContent.tsx from `origin/main` in the same running console): `r29678_help` stays at `/apps/com.qa.r29678` with an empty `main` for all three;
  - after: all three land on `/apps/com.qa.r29678/docs/com.qa.r29678/r29678_guide` (the portal's canonical in-book URL) and read the doc;
  - control `r29678_ctrl`: `/apps/r29678_ctrl/showcase_task` in both legs, for all three;
  - `r29678_locked_app`: the server drops the unreadable entry, so all three get "Nothing in R29678 Locked is available to you yet" in both legs; nobody is sent to a refused doc page.
  Screenshots and the JSON readings are in the project files under `issue-29678/shots/`; the seat links them.
- Not changed, reported to the seat as a finding: an app whose entries are all `url`/`action` links, or live only under `areas`, still opens to an empty `main` (measured live on this head: `r29678_urlonly`, one `url` entry, empty `main` for admin, reader and outsider).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appServesNoNavigation.ts`'s docblock still lists `doc` among the entries the landing resolver never lands on. It is outside this card's file surface, so it is left for the seat.
